name: zclass_node_get_name
description: zClass_Class::gwNodeGetName returns the node name pointer, or null for a null node after reporting the standard null-node error.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zClass metadata accessor source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x447e30 validates returning ECX directly for a non-null node, and the null-node path through zError::ReportOldNoOp followed by a null return.
The native zClass metadata smoke verifies the returned pointer is node.name and that a null node returns null.
